method: Single reviewer heuristic audit, current-run cloud Chrome interaction and screenshots; no independent usability panel or psychological performance study

Fitts: Target size, spacing and reach; DOM measurements where recorded
Jakob: Familiar conventions, predictable labels and consistent navigation
Cognitive load: Plain language, recognition, useful defaults and manageable steps
Proximity: Related facts and actions grouped together; errors beside fields
Peak-end: Clear, truthful completion and calm recovery at difficult moments

journeys.title: Enter ChopDot
journeys.actions: Continue as guest → Home
journeys.observation: Clear guest primary, separate account alternatives, generous primary targets.
journeys.limitations: Account creation and sign-in not exercised.

journeys.title: Home orientation
journeys.actions: Empty Home → Start group; populated Home → Open group
journeys.observation: Primary start is clear; eight secondary destinations compete and look disabled.
journeys.limitations: Large collections and returning real accounts not sampled.

journeys.title: Create group
journeys.actions: Name/currency → create → confirmation
journeys.observation: Two-field task and next-step confirmation support low load and closure.
journeys.limitations: Alternate create errors and shared-account creation not sampled.

journeys.title: Invite / join
journeys.actions: Add local person → Done; members → Invite → Share screen
journeys.observation: Actual invite screen groups link/person alternatives well; earlier local-person panel is buried.
journeys.limitations: No invitation transmitted; remote join, claim and recovery not exercised.

journeys.title: Add expense
journeys.actions: Amount/description → split → reload draft → save → Back to group
journeys.observation: Live share feedback and success receipt work; blank fields need visible guidance.
journeys.limitations: Guest Change method route blocked by Chromium; unequal guest split not assessed.

journeys.title: Inspect / correct
journeys.actions: Inspect → Edit → Cancel; review status → History
journeys.observation: Facts are chunked, exact shares visible, cancellation works; status destination is surprising.
journeys.limitations: No correction submitted in this audit; retained earlier engineering tests are not new UX evidence.

journeys.title: Review / agree / issue
journeys.health: Good main task; minor duplicate completion action
journeys.actions: Reviewer fixture → review → Something off → Cancel → Looks right → reviewed → group
journeys.observation: Clear agree/issue alternatives and truthful all-reviewed receipt; duplicate Back to group choices.
journeys.limitations: Issue submission/reply/reset not replayed; actor fixture toolbar excluded from product scoring.

journeys.title: Group Home
journeys.actions: Saved expense → Group Home; change reviewer actor
journeys.observation: Own next action changes with actor, balances and recent item grouped; no second fixture expense store used.
journeys.limitations: Larger queues and disputed expenses not sampled here.

journeys.title: Manage people
journeys.actions: Group People → member list → Invite someone
journeys.observation: Identity/role grouping and focused Invite action are clear.
journeys.limitations: Role edits, removal and cross-group member history not exercised.

journeys.title: Overall position
journeys.actions: View balances → Back to balances → People / Groups
journeys.observation: Net, owe and owed totals distinguished; group rows trace the underlying scope.
journeys.limitations: Multiple currencies, larger groups and mixed directions not sampled.

journeys.title: Settle up
journeys.actions: Select person in group → Settle amount → preparation
journeys.observation: Person, group and currency stay visible; full amount and selected source are inspectable.
journeys.limitations: Partial amount and multi-group combinations not replayed; sign convention warrants user testing.

journeys.title: Complete settlement
journeys.health: Good unknown-result safety; review visibility question
journeys.actions: Continue → inert TWINT handoff → simulated unknown → recovery
journeys.observation: Unknown is explicit and prevents success claims; recovery returns to same payment.
journeys.limitations: No funds, external app or real receipt; terminal/partial completion not sampled; fixture changes viewport.

journeys.title: Request money
journeys.actions: Person owed → Request payment → request composition
journeys.observation: Amount, person, optional note and covered scope grouped; request/payment distinction concise.
journeys.limitations: Sending, delivery, cancellation and recipient follow-through not exercised.

journeys.title: Receive money
journeys.actions: Receive money → missing receiving details
journeys.observation: One useful next step and concise non-requirement of wallet/bank connection.
journeys.limitations: Populated receiving details and share flow not exercised.

journeys.title: Settlement history
journeys.actions: Open payment history with no payments
journeys.observation: Read-only meaning is explicit, but empty-state sentence wraps one word per line.
journeys.limitations: Populated records and all filters not exercised.

journeys.title: Savings group
journeys.actions: Create goal without date → advance twice → late error → Back twice → fix → create → home
journeys.observation: Draft survives Back; required date error appears two steps away from its field.
journeys.limitations: Only self-member, individual holding and CHF sampled; shared custody not exercised.

journeys.title: Contribute / withdraw
journeys.health: Good sampled review; copy needs polish
journeys.actions: Add money → CHF10 → review contribution
journeys.observation: Exact before/after and group scope are clear at review.
journeys.limitations: Submission, withdrawal and external confirmation not exercised.

journeys.title: Activity / notifications
journeys.actions: Activity → Notifications → Back to Activity
journeys.observation: Expense event opens a clear record; unread is distinguished from unresolved.
journeys.limitations: Read-all, many events and failed refresh not sampled.

journeys.title: Insights
journeys.actions: Insights overview from actual CHF20 expense
journeys.observation: Sparse history is disclosed without fabricating a trend; supporting explanation is technical.
journeys.limitations: Trend comprehension, many groups and period switching not measured.

journeys.title: Payment methods
journeys.actions: Empty methods → Bank transfer form → Cancel
journeys.observation: Visible field labels are helpful; four competing Add choices and tiny Cancel need polish.
journeys.limitations: No real receiving details entered; save, preference and validation outcomes not exercised.

journeys.title: Wallet / crypto
journeys.actions: Account → Wallet disconnected
journeys.observation: Disconnected state is truthful; repeated simulation/authority explanations bury task.
journeys.limitations: No provider, connection, signing, balance or fee action executed.

journeys.title: QR flows
journeys.actions: Scan QR initial screen
journeys.observation: Explicit permission/action separation, but initial Rescan and fixture references add choices.
journeys.limitations: No camera permission, scan or QR payload tested.

journeys.title: Import
journeys.actions: Import entry from journey menu
journeys.observation: Separate new group meaning is concise; visible bottom navigation differs in behavior and labels across families.
journeys.limitations: No package uploaded; format/mapping/identity/conflict/apply flows not exercised.

journeys.title: Export / portability
journeys.actions: Prepare account export → exact snapshot preview
journeys.observation: Scope/counts appear before export; raw identifiers and hashes overwhelm the preview.
journeys.limitations: No final artifact generated/downloaded; export completeness not tested by this UX audit.

journeys.title: Storage / recovery
journeys.actions: Open storage and recovery entry
journeys.observation: Browser-local limitation disclosed; backup/recovery/sync choices separated.
journeys.limitations: No backup, restore or sync operation executed.

journeys.title: Group lifecycle
journeys.actions: All groups → UX audit group settings
journeys.observation: History/lifecycle separation retained; group choices sit far below explanation with little row affordance.
journeys.limitations: No archive, transfer, leave or destructive action executed.

journeys.title: Account / preferences
journeys.actions: Guest account → verified local Entry fixture → Profile
journeys.observation: Identity truth retained, but ordinary settings foreground engineering terms.
journeys.limitations: Fixture session is synthetic; no real auth, name edit, deletion or preference change.

journeys.title: Failure / recovery
journeys.health: Safe sampled unknown; copy needs polish
journeys.actions: Payment Recovery options → Return to owning journey
journeys.observation: Same operation/payment is preserved; unknown accepted amount remains CHF0; no replacement fabricated.
journeys.limitations: Other offline/conflict/save-failure owner types not replayed.

findings.title: Required Savings date is validated two steps late
findings.evidence: Leave target date blank at step1; choose people; continue; Review group at step3 reports Choose a target date. Back twice to correct it.
findings.recommendation: Validate required goal fields on Choose people, mark requirements, and focus the date error beside its field. Preserve draft and final authoritative validation.
findings.authority_boundary: Integration behavior correction; check C1 allows earlier validation, no new product rule.

findings.title: Empty-state text is constrained to a narrow column
findings.evidence: Payment history and Savings Recent render ordinary sentences as a one-word vertical stack inside a wide card.
findings.recommendation: Give empty-state prose its full card width; avoid inheriting icon/text/action grid columns; retain exact semantic copy.
findings.authority_boundary: CSS integration repair; compare the same empty states against approved source layouts.

findings.title: Bottom navigation changes composition across families
findings.evidence: Core uses Pots/People/Add/Activity/You; account/data/lifecycle use Pots/Groups/Add/People/You. Import displays a footer with non-actionable text in the AX tree. Recovery links intentionally route through an owner boundary.
findings.recommendation: Keep approved destinations/permissions, but resolve a consistent integrated navigation contract; unavailable destinations must look unavailable and explain why. Never make blocked actions silently successful.
findings.authority_boundary: Cross-Golden/C1 product decision may be needed for navigation composition; record separately before changing frozen sources.

findings.certainty: Confirmed content burden; usability impact inferred
findings.title: Engineering concepts dominate ordinary task copy
findings.evidence: Profile discusses cryptographic identity/personhood; Wallet repeats inert fixture/no signing disclaimers; export shows long source hashes, participant IDs and unverified-export-reference as primary review facts.
findings.recommendation: Use one concise prototype notice; put detailed provenance/authority diagnostics behind Details. Translate owner truth into current status and Return to payment. Keep all meaningful safety and limitation disclosures.
findings.authority_boundary: Copy/progressive disclosure needs comparison with approved copy and documented post-Golden impacts; no guardrail weakening.

findings.title: Empty Home exposes many secondary destinations
findings.evidence: Eight destination buttons under the first-group task use dashed pale styling similar to unavailable controls.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize Start group; collect secondary tasks into predictable navigation or a labelled More section. Enabled secondary controls should look enabled.
findings.authority_boundary: Hierarchy change needs bounded Golden-impact review; do not remove supported journeys.

findings.title: Guest expense Back to group lands on Home
findings.evidence: After saving UX audit dinner, Back to group opens the Home list; Open UX audit group is another required action.
findings.recommendation: Return to the newly affected group, or accurately label the Home destination. Preserve the canonical group selection.
findings.authority_boundary: Integration route fix; preserve the accepted group-home meaning.

findings.title: Review status routes an unassigned owner to History
findings.evidence: The 0 of1 reviewed / Status row opens History twice, including a semantic-label click. Source gate-b/app.js routes unassigned actors to history intentionally; owner is not eligible to agree as reviewer.
findings.recommendation: Offer a read-only review-status summary or label the History destination clearly. Do not let owners manufacture another participant review.
findings.authority_boundary: Read-only status presentation; permission behavior is correct, not a security defect.

findings.title: Blank expense fields lack visible task labels
findings.evidence: Amount and description have accessible names, but blank visible lines provide little guidance about what to type.
findings.recommendation: Retain accessible labels and add persistent visible Amount/Description labels or approved hints that survive input.
findings.authority_boundary: Compare against approved Golden; visible-copy addition needs bounded review.

findings.title: Small secondary targets and type
findings.evidence: Inspect See all measured32×11CSSpx with10px type; form Cancel396×34 with9px type. Main actions are large; Back is36×36. Some targets are measured in expanded menus.
findings.recommendation: Increase secondary hit area and readable type while keeping visual hierarchy. Check neighboring target spacing and actual touch behavior.
findings.authority_boundary: CSS/target repair; no blanket WCAG violation asserted from dimensions alone.

findings.title: Local add-person panel sits below the success screen
findings.evidence: Gate A create confirmation remains above injected person form; Done is near/under fixed actions until scrolling. Actual J04 invite screen is much clearer.
findings.recommendation: Focus the local-person panel and ensure Done stays visible; reuse approved Invite layout only where semantics match.
findings.authority_boundary: Integration layout repair; local named person is not a verified remote membership.

findings.title: Expense history shows raw timestamps/action names
findings.evidence: History displays create and an ISO timestamp instead of a readable event/date. Activity already has more readable timestamps.
findings.recommendation: Render Created expense and local date/time; retain exact timestamp in Details.
findings.authority_boundary: Presentation-only; history bytes and lineage stay unchanged.

findings.title: Rescan and local-reference checks appear before the first scan
findings.evidence: Initial QR screen mixes Scan, Check reference, Rescan and Return account. Local fixture explanation is shown in ordinary mode.
findings.recommendation: Show Rescan after a result; separate the prototype reference tool from the normal scanner path, retaining explicit simulation disclosure.
findings.authority_boundary: State-dependent presentation; no camera permission or external payload was exercised.

observations_and_limits: Browser route limitation: guest Split equally / Change method rendered chrome-error://chromewebdata and This page has been blocked by Chromium. One parent reload recovered the draft. This is not a site-served bot challenge, not a semantic validator failure and not a assessed split-method UX state.

Fixture-only visibility question: J12 Continue entered a review screen scrolled down so amount/recipient were above the visible viewport. Yellow test controls reduce usable height. Reproduce in normal mode before treating it as a shipped scroll-reset defect.

Comprehension hypothesis: person position is positive when owed on the summary but shows negative terms in its How it adds up calculation. Test understanding before changing any approved mathematical sign convention.
Minor polish: reviewed receipt has two identical Back to group actions. Avoid duplicate equivalent choices where the source-approved train/footer distinction no longer matters.
Session caveat: verified local Entry fixture is a synthetic capability precondition; Home still showing Guest is not evidence about real authenticated account behavior.

scope: No code, frozen authority, schema, deployment or user data changed. Only disposable browser-local synthetic audit data.
completed_claim: 28/28 families sampled; all alternate states not tested; no universal PASS verdict.
